request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: M16 art-direction concept board for The Last Beacon, an original desktop 2D tower defense game.
Create one polished landscape concept board, about 3:2 aspect ratio, on warm ivory parchment with generous clean spacing. Hand-painted 2D fantasy, three-quarter overhead game view, clear readable silhouettes, consistent upper-left daylight, matte stone/oak/leather/steel textures, restrained dark outlines. All nine panels belong to one cohesive art direction, designed to remain readable when enemies are 36–48 pixels tall on a 64-pixel square tile.
Composition: a three-column by three-row board. Top row, three separate full-body enemy character concepts, facing three-quarter toward the viewer's lower right: GOBLIN, SCOUT, OGRE. Middle row, three compact Dawn Guard defensive tower concepts on square bases: BASIC, RAPID, LONGBOW. Bottom row, three small environment/gate vignettes: BORDER, GROVE, KEEP. Use these short labels verbatim, small and unobtrusive, no other writing.
Top left GOBLIN: small moss-green raider, pointed ears, hunched back, chipped short blade, worn purple tunic and loot pouch, expressive mischievous face. Top center SCOUT: slender green goblin leaning into a run, long legs, a short ochre-orange cape, leather hood, two small daggers. Top right OGRE: broad heavy monster, tusks, dark blue-gray iron shoulder armor, reinforced wooden shield, worn purple Hollow Host emblem; visibly larger and heavier than goblins.
Middle left BASIC: stone-and-oak border watchtower, one blue-steel crossbow, small blue/gold Dawn Guard banner. Middle center RAPID: lower light oak repeater platform, two clearly visible crossbow limbs, bolt magazine, green cloth trim, compact silhouette. Middle right LONGBOW: reinforced stone/oak platform, long amber-wood bow limbs, taut string, strong readable silhouette. Fixed bases and aiming mechanisms are visually distinct. All footprints fit one square game tile.
Bottom left BORDER: muted warm border grass, wheel-worn dirt road, crude goblin timber entry, small Dawn stone-and-timber watchpost gate with a warm golden beacon. Bottom center GROVE: mossy forest trail, low roots and violet flowers, old-root entry arch and moss-covered defense gate. Bottom right KEEP: cracked-stone road and subdued gray grass, ruined enemy entry masonry, a crenellated Dawn gate with blue/gold banners and the last golden beacon.
Palette: ivory #e9dcc4, stone #c6b89c, oak #70523a, blue steel #526e7e, beacon gold #f2c76b, border grass #7f965d, moss #536e50, goblin skin #78944f, Hollow purple #73556f, scout ochre #c58b4d. Backgrounds remain quieter than units. Preserve clean margins around each concept; no overlapping panels, weapons cropped off, realistic gore, modern firearms, photorealism, watermarks, logos, game statistics or production sprite grids. This is concept art, not a finished sprite sheet or screenshot.
